description: This header defines the 'strvec' API for managing dynamic, NULL-terminated arrays of strings in C. It provides structures, macros, and function declarations for initializing, manipulating, and freeing string vectors, with features such as pushing, inserting, removing, splitting, and splicing string elements.

methods.name: strvec_init
methods.description: Initializes a strvec instance, setting its array pointer to a default empty state.

methods.name: strvec_push
methods.description: Pushes a copy of a string onto the end of the strvec, duplicating the string.

methods.name: strvec_push_nodup
methods.description: Pushes a string onto the strvec, taking ownership of the provided string pointer.

methods.name: strvec_pushf
methods.description: Formats a string with printf-style arguments and pushes it onto the strvec.

methods.name: strvec_pushl
methods.description: Pushes a list of strings onto the end of the strvec; arguments are NULL-terminated.

methods.name: strvec_pushv
methods.description: Pushes a NULL-terminated array of strings onto the strvec.

methods.name: strvec_splice
methods.description: Replaces a segment of the strvec with a new set of strings, allowing insertion or deletion.

methods.name: strvec_replace
methods.description: Replaces the string at a given index with a new string.

methods.name: strvec_remove
methods.description: Removes the string at a specified index, shifting subsequent elements.

methods.name: strvec_pop
methods.description: Removes the last string from the strvec.

methods.name: strvec_split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens by whitespace and pushes them into the strvec.

methods.name: strvec_clear
methods.description: Frees all memory used by the strvec and resets it.

methods.name: strvec_detach
methods.description: Detaches the array pointer from the strvec struct, relinquishing ownership.
